NVDA.text: Nvidia jumped 8.7% after its quarterly beat and a stronger long-term revenue outlook reassured investors that AI infrastructure demand remains robust.

AVGO.text: Broadcom rose 4.5% with the Nvidia-led semiconductor rally after Nvidia's outlook strengthened confidence in sustained AI infrastructure spending; no separate Broadcom-specific catalyst was confirmed.

TSM.text: TSM rose 2.3% with the Nvidia-led chip rally as Nvidia's stronger AI demand outlook supported expectations for continued advanced-semiconductor demand; no fresh TSM-specific catalyst was confirmed.

ASML.text: ASML fell 0.6% despite the Nvidia-led chip rally, with no fresh ASML-specific catalyst confirmed and reports of possible broader U.S. semiconductor tariffs creating an offsetting policy overhang.

KLAC.text: KLA finished essentially flat despite the Nvidia-led chip rally, with no fresh company-specific catalyst confirmed and possible new U.S. semiconductor tariffs adding policy uncertainty for chip equipment.

INTC.text: Intel rose 4.4% as Nvidia's strong results and long-term forecast sparked a broad semiconductor rally; no separate Intel-specific catalyst was confirmed.

MU.text: Micron slipped 0.3%, reversing an early Nvidia-led chip gain; no fresh Micron-specific catalyst was confirmed, leaving the close as relative underperformance within an otherwise strong semiconductor session.

TSLA.text: Tesla rose 2.6% during the broader technology rally while investors continued to digest its Nevada robotaxi approval; no stronger same-day Tesla-specific catalyst was confirmed.

META.text: Meta fell 0.9% despite the broader technology rally as Poland asked the EU to fine the company €250 million over alleged failures to curb scam advertisements.

PLTR.text: Palantir rose 4.7% as the Nvidia-led AI rally lifted technology shares and its strong post-earnings momentum continued; no fresh company-specific catalyst was confirmed.

SPCX.text: SpaceX rose 0.9% as investors continued digesting its recently announced $100 billion Louisiana Starbase plan; no newer same-day company-specific catalyst was confirmed.
